name: Love Me Dead
source:
You've risen from the dead, but there's a catch – only love can make you whole again. And thanks to a questionable research project, you've got three potential candidates.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你已经从死里复活，但有一个问题——只有爱才能让你再次完整。由于一项有问题的研究项目，你得到了三位潜在的候选人。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
